digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and history reclaim
propositions: The tickets-store pack size exceeds the CI Verified gate limit (131,072 KiB) and must be reclaimed below 150 MiB through history rewrite and compaction to unblock Gerrit landings.
Off-repo backup bundles must be created before any mutation and verified by restore; a final bundle is required after the coordinated repair ticket 30d3 execution before history rewrite begins.
The history rewrite uses git fast-export/filter/fast-import to strip spent bridge_state history and must preserve tree, commit count, and merge-count equivalence with pre-rewrite state.

The identity-report event multiset (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) must remain byte-identical before and after rewrite when commit SHAs are ignored; rebar.toml identity.enforce_since must be re-pinned through Gerrit after publication.
Exact force-with-lease publication must succeed with rewritten tip; old tip must not be reachable from any ref in the published repository and must not be an ancestor after fresh clone.

Deterministic first post-rewrite write must occur with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off disabled, consist of exactly one review-bot vote sequence (CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, reciprocal links), remain below 1 MiB growth, and retain old-tip non-ancestry.
